title: Senior Surveyor
description:
Overview

UTEC, part of Acteon Group, is one of the world's largest independent offshore and onshore survey providers. We provide a wide range of survey, positioning and data management services using the most advanced equipment and techniques. The data we generate provides our clients with the information they need to make critical, well informed, business decisions.

UTEC is looking to add a Senior Surveyor to the team. The Senior Surveyor is UTEC's senior representative on a watch reporting to Party Chief or senior representative on vessel and must ensure that all work is conducted in the best interests of UTEC and the Client. He/She must thoroughly understand work specifications, project requirements and client objectives, and is responsible for the safe, efficient and timely execution of, as well as Quality Assurance for the project.

The role is based offshore and will require travel to support UTEC operations, periods of onshore support may also be required working either remotely or from UTEC offices/workshops.

The successful candidates will be based in Brazil.

Duties

  • Supervise survey operations ensuring safe working practices at all times and with due regard to contractual requirements, scope of work, procedures and regulations
  • Manage mobilization and demobilization activities with regard to safety of personnel and assets
  • Ensure all systems are functioning in compliance with contractual requirements, project procedures and company procedures to effectively conduct the scope of work
  • Ensure collection, collation, QC and distribution of all survey data relating to the scope of work as per project procedures and company procedures
  • Advise onshore management, company and client representatives when deviation from the approved procedure is necessary and record through the Management of Change Procedure
  • Compile operational / field reporting in a concise manner and in accordance with project procedures, client specifications and company procedures
  • Complete final reporting and data transfer / backup in accordance with project procedures, client specifications and company procedures
  • Effectively communicate with client representatives and company representatives onshore
  • Ensure all personnel in the offshore team understand their roles and responsibilities
  • Conduct personnel performance reviews/appraisals for your direct reports and provide specific performance data/feedback to supervisors of non-direct reports assigned to your projects
  • Actively participate and lead by example in the Company's Quality and HSE systems and procedures
  • Understand and comply with UTEC policies and procedures
  • Be prepared to "Stop the Job" in the event that yourself, others or equipment may be exposed to injury / damage
  • Comply with all Health and Safety instructions from UTEC
  • Correctly handle all Health and Safety equipment
  • Recognize and help control HSE hazards where applicable
  • Report all Health, Safety and Environment incidents to management, including near misses, unsafe acts and hazards
  • Utilize the Safety Observation Sheet (SOS) reporting system
  • Help generate, update and review risk assessments and job safety analysis, where applicable
  • Understand emergency plans, alarms and actions required in the event of an emergency
  • Participate in relevant HSE meetings and "tool box talks" within respective department
  • Demonstrate conversance with the Project HSE Plan where applicable to this position/department
  • Participate in accident investigations where required
  • Assume all employee responsibilities listed in the Workplace Safety and Health Act
  • Comply with return-to-work and / or rehabilitation program(s)
  • Adhere to the 'UTEC Way 12 Safety and Quality Principles' at all times

Required

  • Bilingual in Portuguese and English, strongly preferred
  • Education in Geomatics, Surveying Science
  • Relevant industry experience or military/academic experience in survey related discipline
  • Satisfactory completion of the competence criteria for Surveyor Grade I
  • Nominally 24 months experience, including 200 operational days offshore as a Surveyor Grade I

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Associate to join our growing offshore team. The ideal candidate will assist in managing financial records, processing transactions, and supporting accounting functions to ensure smooth financial operations.

Eligibility and Application Details

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in the preparation of financial statements and reports
  • Process accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions
  • Reconcile key accounts, including bank statements, and ensure accuracy in financial records
  • Support month-end and year-end closing procedures
  • Maintain documentation and records for auditing and compliance purposes
  • Work closely with the team to optimize accounting processes
  • Assist in managing day-to-day client communications, responding to questions and information requests

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

  • Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks
  • Comfortable learning and navigating new systems and tools
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and other key stakeholders
  • Eligibility for Latin America residents
  • Application language and Loom video guidance included in the application process

Certifications

  • Strong preference would be a degree in Accounting, with Finance or related fields being secondary.
  • If they have a degree in a related field, an accounting certification would be a plus

Must Haves

  • Full professional proficiency, both spoken and written. We work very closely with our offshore associates so it’s imperative to minimize communication issues
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in an accounting or bookkeeping role, preferably with a US based company
  • This associate will be working on bank reconciliations, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, etc., so they should have experience preparing those types of reconciliations in a previous role
  • Experience with Quickbooks Online (it’s not 100% must-have but is a very large bonus)

Nice to Haves

  • Work experience at one of the big four US accounting firms (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Deloitte, Ernst & Young)
  • Ability to create or improve processes. We’re a fast paced start up and don’t always have lengthy process documentation available.
  • Experience in Netsuite, Bill.com and/or Ramp

Work Schedule

Typically, the associate’s schedule would be 9AM - 6PM EST. We have flexibility to shift that window an hour either way but this is the time the vast majority of our clients are online.

Perks

  • Competitive USD compensation
  • PTO Policy in addition to US Holiday Schedule
  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing company
  • Positive and collaborative work environment

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

title: Process Engineer Specialist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Process Engineer Specialist role at Shape Digital .

An Industrial Process Engineer here at Shape works closely with a multidisciplinary Agile team to build cutting-edge advanced analytics solutions. These solutions will generate insights from our connected data, enabling the team to advance the data-driven decision-making capabilities of our enterprise. This role requires a deep understanding of engineering, troubleshooting, and monitoring of industrial processes and equipment. They work closely with Data Scientists and Product Owners to ensure business value and quality.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the technical mentor and facilitator in the development of studies of process and performance for operational efficiency and compliance with the international standards for quality and safety.
  • Contribute to developing advanced analytics solutions for condition monitoring and performance optimization of industrial assets.
  • Compile and digest industrial technical documentation as operational manuals, datasheets and P&IDs to gather information that will be utilized as input for data-driven models.
  • Develop root cause analysis studies of industry failure events to identify new opportunities for development and improvement of Shape's portfolio of digital solutions.
  • Explore and develop mathematical modeling of industrial thermodynamic processes to support data-driven solutions development.
  • Explore historical time-series data of process equipment to validate hypotheses and test modeling techniques.
  • Implement Shape's digital products in new clients as well as supporting development of new features.
  • Problem framing: participate in problem framing together with business owners, data scientists and other engineers for identified opportunities.

Requirements

  • Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field, with a deep understanding of process engineering theories and practices.
  • Proven experience in the Oil & Gas industry, with strong knowledge of industrial processes, operations, and predictive monitoring of critical assets.
  • Solid understanding of industrial systems and equipment, including practical knowledge of sensing technologies, protection systems, performance control, efficiency optimization, technical specifications, and common failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience with PI AF (Asset Framework) for data analysis and the development of predictive models, driving actionable insights and process improvements.
  • Expertise in asset performance and integrity management, with the ability to lead and facilitate structured engineering studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, RCA, FMEA, and RCM.
  • In-depth knowledge of industrial process operations and control, enabling the analysis of systems involving multiple interconnected pieces of equipment.
  • Basic knowledge of industrial automation, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), dedicated protection systems, and condition monitoring technologies.
  • Technical familiarity with data collection and storage systems, including vibration data acquisition, PIMS platforms, and OPC servers.
  • Working knowledge of data analysis, machine learning algorithms, and digital software system architectures.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and tools for continuous improvement and process optimization.
  • Language: Advanced English proficiency.
  • Certification: CREA certification is mandatory.
  • Willingness to work at our offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

Benefits

  • Massages and Manicure in the Office: So you can relax and feel good about yourself.
  • Mentorship Program: Access development opportunities with the help of experienced professionals.

  • Day off in Your Birthday Month: A day off in your birthday month to celebrate in any way you prefer.
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: Support for time with your family while maintaining professional stability.
  • Childcare Assistance: Support for care of young children.
  • Continuous Individualized Development Support: Support for your professional growth, respecting your personal needs and goals.
  • Culture and Well-being: An environment that values mental health, work-life balance, and cultural engagement.

Você fará parte de um ambiente altamente colaborativo, dinâmico e inovador, onde ideias são valorizadas e experimentação é incentivada. Nosso objetivo é encontrar soluções criativas e práticas para entregar os melhores resultados aos nossos clientes. Buscamos profissionais com um histórico de excelência em qualidade e foco no cliente, que prosperem em cenários rápidos e desafiadores, e que estejam prontos para atuar em contextos de alta ambiguidade e constantes mudanças.

Se você gosta de desafios e está preparado para liderar e entregar resultados em um ambiente que combina o dinamismo de uma start-up com a estrutura de uma grande empresa, queremos conhecer você!

Key job responsibilities

  • Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega, no turno da noite. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados;
  • Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes;
  • Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos;
  • Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente;
  • Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais;
  • Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico;
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback;
  • Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções;
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário;
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Qualifications

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência em Operações de segmentos como Logística, Manufatura, Indústria geral e áreas afins;
  • Experiencia com gestão de pessoas;
  • MS Office, com nível intermediário em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no período da noite (23h as 10h) e em turnos flexíveis, incluindo fins de semana e feriados;
  • Inglês intermediário e Português fluente;
  • Experiencia em E-commerce;
  • Conhecimentos em gestão de projetos ou de processos;
  • Inglês Avançado.

At Amazon we treat every single day like its day one. And we never sit still while we do it. Are you up for crafting solutions and solving tomorrow’s problems today? Then we have the opportunity for you!

We’re seeking a Delivery Station Manager to join our Amazon Logistics team in Rio de Janeiro - RJ. You’ll operate out of one of our dynamic Delivery Stations: they are at the heart of Amazon’s rapidly growing Operations and Logistics network: they’re where we sort and process our parcels.

As a Delivery Station Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, supportive leadership for the teams you lead. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves and getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for developing a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Senior Operations Manager. The quality of your leadership is key to success in this role: you’ll tactfully motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.

Another key aspect of the role is to lead on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you lead. The ideas, innovation and leaps out of the status quo that you come up with could very well be rolled out across the Amazon network: this immense opportunity is yours for the taking.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Maintaining Health and Safety standards within your remit area, while promoting and inspiring a culture of safety on-site;
  • Become proficient on specific, larger-scale processes and activities within Delivery Stations, such as 5S audits;
  • In your inventory control and systems environment, you’ll handle meaningful data collection, updating operations metrics on an hourly basis;
  • Therefore, you’ll aim to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors and ensure an excellent customer experience;
  • Partnering closely with other support teams (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, IT) on staffing plans, schedules and performance levels;
  • Implement progressive process change and contribute in cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your site and the broader Brazil Amazon Logistics network.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Employee and performance management experience;
  • Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams;
  • Expertise in two or more production or supply chain areas, with an impressive track record in a similar, dynamic logistics, distribution or manufacturing environment;
  • Ability to organize details, establish and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyze the data you generate
  • Advanced level in Excel (vlookup, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros);
  • Willingness to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and holidays;
  • Fluent Portuguese and basic English;
  • Completed master’s degree or MBA; Experience with Kaizen and Lean methodologies and related techniques;
  • Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations;

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit the for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Project Manager Brazil - Renewable Natural Gas
description:
Join to apply for the Project Manager Brazil - Renewable Natural Gas role at Waga Energy

Waga Energy was established to further our founders' commitments to preserving the common good and acting collectively to ensure a sustainable future.

Committed to the fight against global warming and to a sustainable energy transition, Waga Energy has developed a breakthrough technology to recover landfill gas into biomethane, also called Renewable Natural Gas (RNG). Our WAGABOX landfill gas upgrading units deliver high-quality biomethane, regardless of the quality of the raw biogas. The biomethane produced by the WAGABOX can be injected directly into the gas grid or used as fuel for vehicles. Waga Energy builds, owns, operates, and maintains the WAGABOX units under long-term contracts with landfill owners.

Already in operation at dozens of landfill sites worldwide, this revolutionary landfill gas purification solution has been producing clean, local renewable energy since 2015. Waga Energy is committed to driving a sustainable energy transition by making RNG accessible to all.

Guided by the values of Audacity, Mastery, and Cooperation, Waga Energy employees in Europe, North America, and other locations are united by a common purpose: maintaining a livable planet for future generations.

About the Position - Responsibilities & Duties

Waga Energy is currently seeking candidates for the position of Project Manager in Brazil (RJ or SP area).

The ability to accommodate +/- 25% domestic travel time (including overnight stays) and site work is required for this position. Some international travel may also be required.

This is an exciting, rewarding position promoting the role of renewable energies, notably renewable gas, in the future of energy transition.

The Project Manager will serve as a member of a collaborative project team (based in France), responsible for managing landfill biogas-to-RNG projects via the successful delivery and operations of our WAGABOX units. The Project Manager role is a highly responsible role supporting projects from the initial feasibility analysis stage through planning, design, permitting, construction, and ongoing operations.

Associated responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Managing technical challenges, project management responsibilities, and client/project partner relationships to ensure both successful project execution and professional growth and advancement.
  • Developing and executing project scope, budget, and schedule from FEED studies through to project delivery and site construction, while ensuring adherence to timeline, cost, quality and safety objectives.
  • Managing all applicable regulatory and permitting related tasks to ensure compliance with local, state, national, and industry codes and standards, including drafting and tracking requests for authorization.
  • Managing the procurement of local equipment, supplies, and services essential for delivering the project within established budget and schedule, and assisting the project team in France with procurement made in France, while ensuring that engineering and process documents comply with local regulations and requirements. This includes coordinating with the Waga process department and outside equipment suppliers.
  • Tracking and documenting project information (internal and external) including procurement, scheduling, and progress documentation.
  • Managing subcontractors including subcontractor engineers, equipment manufacturers, and site contractors to obtain quotes/proposals, oversee work to ensure adherence to the project plan, budget, and quality standards, and track change requests.
  • Assisting the Business Development team regarding technical aspects of potential projects (site visits).
  • Managing civil work, pre-commissioning and commissioning activities: organize site construction in line with the schedule, manage site co-activity with safety and other rules, ensure subcontracting contracts are properly implemented, and involve other departments (EIA, process); participate in pre-commissioning and commissioning activities.
  • Ensuring the successful handover of new projects to the facility operations team.
  • Supporting ongoing operations via technical troubleshooting and system checks of WAGABOX units as needed.
  • Maintaining a continuous focus on safety and process optimization/improvement throughout all project phases, making suggestions and taking actions as needed.
  • Drafting grant applications when relevant.

About You - Qualifications & Skills

The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic, self-motivated professional with:

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical, mechanical, process, electrical or related).
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a project management role.
  • Background in pressure equipment design, process piping, and rotating equipment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office. Experience with engineering software (e.g., DraftSight, AutoCAD, or similar) is a plus.
  • Expertise in the conception and commissioning of equipment within gas, chemical, or heat production industries. Ability to work on-site to participate in pre-commissioning and commissioning activities.
  • In-depth knowledge of engineering documentation and its practical application.
  • Solid understanding of electrical and automation systems.
  • Proven experience in project management and EPC project control, ensuring successful project execution.
  • Knowledgeable in contracts, budgeting, accounting, and supply chain management.
  • Familiar with relevant ASME codes, as well as civil and structural engineering principles.
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (knowledge of French is a plus).

Resume and cover letters have to be sent in English.

Culture

Faced with the urgent need to act to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, Waga Energy employees have committed themselves to take meaningful action to contribute to sustainable energy transition and the construction of a more environmentally friendly society. In serving as members of this committed team of professionals, Waga Energy employees are supported in meeting their professional development and career advancement goals within a fair, ethical culture focused on cooperation, humility, integrity, respect, and teamwork.

Waga Energy's recruiting process typically includes the following steps:

  • Interview with human resources team.
  • Candidate completes Predictive Index (PI) cognitive and behavioral assessments.
  • Interview with applicable department manager.
  • Human resources conducts reference checks if needed.
  • Human resources presents an employment offer.

Waga Energy is an equal opportunity employer.

Employment type: Full-time; Job function: Project Management and Information Technology

Not Applicable — Seniority level
